about: Preset status (预设状态) of mechanism assets, as the official sample saves register it in the model component of the prefab ({12: {2: {1: status id, 2: starting value}}}) and as their graphs use it (f.setPresetStatus(entity, statusId, value)). Only assets seen in the samples are listed; 'used' are the values the official graphs set, with what the lesson shows for them. Entries marked 上机筛出 were found on 2026-10-11 by registering the id (asset id - 4000) x 10 and letting the editor's playtest check accept or refuse it (examples/presets); a value the asset does not have is not taken (it reads back the old value).
